items.title: Robinhood's Quirk on ETFs and the Next Generation of Investors
items.summary: Robinhood Markets Chief Brokerage Officer Steve Quirk joins Bloomberg's Katie Greifeld and Eric Balchunas for a special edition of ETF IQ live on stage at the Bloomberg ETFs in Depth Conference in New York on November 26, 2026. Quirk discusses how younger investors are trading through volatile markets, Robinhood's push toward 24/7 access and tokenization, and the firm's evolving role in prediction markets. He also details Robinhood's involvement in Trump Accounts and what the program could mean for a new generation of investors.

items.title: Coinbase Plans Its Own Prediction Markets by Mid-2027. That’s a New Rival for Robinhood
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoinbase is reportedly aiming to launch its own prediction markets in the first half of 2027, moving beyond its Kalshi partnership. Coinbase needs the business more than Robinhood needs to worry about it, with analysts expecting a normalized loss in 2026.

items.title: The Wall Street veteran turning alternative data into infrastructure for everyone
items.summary: Kirk McKeown, Co-Founder and CEO of Carbon Arc, spent years running the alternative data business at Point72 before setting out to make Wall Street’s data edge available to everyone. Carbon Arc is the infrastructure platform he built to do exactly that: removing the legal, compliance, and usability friction that keeps private data locked away from the decision makers who need it most. In this interview at the TomorrowX Summit, Kirk breaks down the Kalshi partnership that made alternative data a settlement framework for prediction markets for the first time, the upcoming Robinhood MCP integration that puts 600 data assets in traders’ hands for $10 a month, and why he believes data structure is the new capital market.

items.title: Robinhood Just Dropped 29% in a Month. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysRobinhood stock fell 29% in the past month as crypto trading slumped, and Coinbase fell even harder in the same selloff. Robinhood’s crypto revenue fell 55% in the third quarter and its October crypto volume fell 48%, but prediction markets now bring in more revenue than crypto, and deposits keep growing.
